_comment: Tier-2 for fourc::brownian_dynamics#3, with two corrections. First, the knob in 4C is PERIODICONOFF inside BINNING STRATEGY, not a 'DESIGN PERIODIC CONDITIONS' block — that string appears in no upstream Polymer_Network deck, and the RVE drive runs through PERIODIC BOUNDINGBOX ELEMENTS plus DESIGN SURF DIRICH CONDITIONS on the box corner nodes. Second, the consequence is not a 5-20% stress error: deleting the single PERIODICONOFF line from upstream beam3r_line2_backweuler_browndyn_periodic_rve_dirich_element.4C.yaml makes node 2 come back 0.00000000000000000e+00 in all three components against a prescribed -2.47500871887900376e-01 axially. The RVE deformation never reaches the filament at all, the run exits normally and 4C prints no warning, so a 'within 20%' screen passes it while a zero-response check catches it immediately. Verified by execution 2026-08-06 against 4C at /home/alexander/4C/build/4C.

_mutation.note: remove the pathology: keep PERIODICONOFF in the second arm. The RVE drive reaches the filament again, the deck passes, PERIODICONOFF_LINES_REMOVED becomes 0 and EXIT_FREE becomes 0, so the fixture must go red.
